trainingmodels

Status: early development. The package is not yet usable. It currently contains only the repository skeleton; no models are implemented.

trainingmodels will provide mathematical models of training load and training response used in sport science: descriptors of daily training load and impulse-response models (starting with the Banister model). A Shiny app for teaching will be added later.

Design decisions are recorded in DECISIONS.md and the use of AI assistance is disclosed in AI_USAGE.md.

Installation

Not yet recommended. The development version will be installable with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("JorgeDelro/trainingmodels")
